title: Room Database
objectives: Get compile-time-checked SQL and reactive queries

sections.markdown: Room is a Jetpack persistence library — an abstraction over SQLite that gives compile-time-verified SQL, less boilerplate, and reactive queries via Flow/LiveData.
Room verifies your SQL **at compile time** — a typo in a @Query fails the build, not at runtime. Returning a Flow makes queries reactive: the UI auto-updates when the table changes.
Shipping a schema change without a migration — Room throws IllegalStateException at runtime. Provide a Migration (or fallbackToDestructiveMigration only in dev) and bump the version.
Keep DB work off the main thread: use suspend DAO functions or Flow. Expose Room behind a Repository so the rest of the app doesn't depend on Room types.

flashcards.front: Key advantage of Room over raw SQLite?
flashcards.back: Compile-time SQL verification, less boilerplate, and reactive Flow/LiveData queries.

flashcards.front: What happens if you change the schema without a migration?
flashcards.back: Room throws at runtime; you must provide a Migration and bump the version.
